business_problem: UPL, a global leader in sustainable agriculture, is dedicated to securing the world’s food supply across 138 countries by enhancing farm productivity and profitability through innovative solutions. Due to their rapid growth, UPL faced significant challenges in managing and analyzing vast amounts of internal and third-party data sources.
solution_summary: UPL built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Delta Sharing, Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines. Due to their rapid growth, UPL faced significant challenges in managing and analyzing vast amounts of internal and third-party data sources. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Delta Sharing shares governed datasets with external partners and downstream consumers. Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines builds transformation pipelines over shared data with Spark-based processing.
